sections.content: You know *Estimados vecinos* and *Atentamente* from B2 Unit 14, *le ruego que* and *sírvase* from B2 Unit 34 and the polite *condicional* from A2 Unit 26. A formal letter is those habits in a fixed order: an opening, the reason for writing, a polite request or closing remark, and a farewell with your name.

sections.title: The parts of a formal letter
rows: Le escribo para pedirle información sobre el curso.
I am writing to ask you for information about the course.
Le escribo para confirmar la reunión del lunes.
I am writing to confirm Monday's meeting.
Quedo a la espera de su respuesta.
I look forward to your reply.

sections.content: Use *usted* forms all the way through, so the pronoun is *le* and *su*: *Le escribo para…*, *su respuesta*. After *para*, the purpose is an infinitive. Put a colon after the greeting and a comma after the farewell. A letter to a friend ends with something like *Un abrazo,*, but never a letter to an office.
Open with *Estimado/a* and keep the reason short: one sentence with *Le escribo para…*. If you do not know the name, *Estimado señor:* or *Estimada señora:* is enough.
